posts.text: Dixon and Gemtek 60:40 JV Gemtek Technology is a Taiwan-based company specializing in broadband, wireless networking, fiber-optic communications, 5G, optical connectivity , and telecom equipment. The company develops and manufactures products used by telecom operators, broadband providers, enterprise networks, and increasingly AI/data-center connectivity. Gemtek brings IP of high margin Optical Fibre equipment required for data centers, where as Dixon brings manufacturing scale plus market. This will be a win-win scenario. Disc: Invested for 4+ years and iam biased.
